name: Kayako
description_en:
Kayako currently offers Kay, an AI support agent that can operate over an existing helpdesk, and Kayako One, a full customer-support platform with inbox, ticketing, knowledge, chat, automation and reporting. Its current sales approach emphasizes expert-led rollout from triage to answers and broader autonomous work. Older Kayako and Classic material describes distinct account generations.

Evaluation should identify the contracted product, existing mailbox and automation model before importing older plan or workflow assumptions. AI action authority, public versus private email content, export coverage and the contractual exit window matter as much as the advertised resolution rate. This is public-source research; no account, refund, rule, migration or restore was tested.
description_zh:
Kayako当前提供可叠加于既有帮助台的AI支持代理Kay，以及包含收件箱、工单、知识、聊天、自动化和报表的完整客服平台Kayako One。当前销售方式强调由专家分阶段实施，从分诊到回答再到更广泛自主工作。旧Kayako和Classic材料则描述不同账户世代。

评估应先明确合同产品、既有邮箱和自动化模型，再引用旧套餐或流程假设。AI动作权限、邮件公开／私有内容、导出覆盖及合同退出窗口，与宣传解决率同样重要。本文为公开来源研究，未测试账户、退款、规则、迁移或恢复。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.

sections.title_en: Separate the AI overlay from the full helpdesk
sections.title_zh: 区分AI叠加层与完整帮助台
sections.en:
The current site offers two implementation paths: Kay runs over an existing helpdesk, while Kayako One provides a full inbox, tickets, knowledge, live chat and reporting platform. The rollout is described as expert-led triage, answers and progressively broader autonomous work. Existing and Classic support articles remain public but should not silently define a new Kay deployment.

For an illustrative refund inquiry, first specify whether the AI is classifying, drafting or actually permitted to change payment/order data. A sample conversation showing a refund is a vendor demonstration, not evidence a buyer’s integration, approval or error path works. Claimed resolution percentages, savings and deployment timelines remain vendor statements.
sections.zh:
当前网站有两条实施路径：Kay运行于既有帮助台之上，Kayako One则提供完整收件箱、工单、知识、聊天和报表平台。实施描述为专家带领分诊、回答并逐渐扩大自主工作。既有及Classic支持文章仍公开，但不能自动定义新Kay部署。

以假设退款询问为例，应先说明AI是在分类、起草，还是确有修改支付／订单数据的权限。展示退款的示例对话属于厂商演示，不能证明买家集成、审批或错误路径可用。解决率、节约及实施时长均保留为厂商陈述。

sections.title_en: A monitor is not an exact-time job
sections.title_zh: 监控器不是准确时点任务
sections.en:
Existing Kayako documentation distinguishes event triggers from hourly monitors. Triggers react to creation or updates; monitors periodically sweep matching conversations, with a documented maximum of one thousand cases in one run. The guide explicitly says a monitor cannot be scheduled for a particular time. Managing either requires the appropriate administrator automation permission.

Use a narrow source-channel condition and a clear action owner. An hourly SLA reminder should not be described as a guaranteed send at an exact deadline. Check whether the actual selected One/Kay account uses this same engine before importing the tutorial. Rule retries, precedence and compensation for external write failures were not established.
sections.zh:
既有Kayako文档区分事件触发器与每小时监控器。触发器响应创建或更新；监控器周期扫描匹配会话，文档上限为每次1000条，并明确不能安排准确执行时点。管理两者需要适当管理员自动化权限。

应限定来源渠道条件并明确动作负责人。每小时SLA提醒不能描述为保证在某准确期限发送。导入教程前应检查实际所选One／Kay账户是否采用相同引擎。规则重试、优先级及外部写入失败补偿未确认。

sections.title_en: Private notes can cross the email-template boundary
sections.title_zh: 私有备注可能跨越邮件模板边界
sections.en:
The support article explains a specific exposure path: a customized reply template using case.posts copies both public and private posts into a customer email. The documented alternative is case.public_posts or restoring the default template. A private label in the agent interface therefore does not prove a custom outgoing template preserves that boundary.

After a domain change, also inspect the reply’s actual destination, brand inbox and old-address threads. The routing article is published under Article Drafts and uses broad fault-free claims; this profile uses it only as a diagnostic prompt, not proof missing messages can never be a vendor defect. Test a complete request/reply cycle with harmless sample notes before changing live routing.
sections.zh:
支持文章解释一种具体泄露路径：自定义回复模板使用case.posts，会把公开及私有帖子都复制至客户邮件。文档替代为case.public_posts或恢复默认模板。因此坐席界面的私有标签不能证明自定义出站模板保留该边界。

更换域名后，还应检查回复真实目的地址、品牌收件箱及旧地址会话。路由文章发布在Article Drafts分类，使用了宽泛无故障主张；本文仅取作排查线索，不当成缺失消息永远不是厂商问题的证据。修改真实路由前应以无敏感示例备注测试完整请求／回复周期。

sections.title_en: Define the billable outcome before forecasting volume
sections.title_zh: 预测用量前定义收费结果
sections.en:
The current Kay offer displays$1 per resolved ticket and no seat or setup fees. It defines resolution as solving the issue without a human agent, including an action or an answer the customer confirms works; escalation, partial resolution and simple deflection are excluded. Kayako One is separately presented as a full platform with a sales conversation required.

Do not use that headline to price every old Kayako account or assume refunds, account updates and returns are automatically authorized. Ask the order to settle a reopened issue, multiple issues in one thread, disputes and the underlying platform/integration scope. The currency code, minimum commitment, invoice period and complete One price were not verified from the public offer.
sections.zh:
当前Kay方案显示每解决工单$1，无席位或设置费。其定义为无需人工解决问题，包括执行动作或客户确认有效的回答；人工升级、部分解决及简单分流排除。Kayako One另以完整平台展示，需要销售沟通。

不能用该标题计算所有旧Kayako账户，也不能假定退款、账户更新及退货自动获授权。应在订单明确重开问题、单线程多问题、争议及底层平台／集成范围。公开方案未确认币种代码、最低承诺、账期或完整One价格。

sections.title_en: Count archived data and settle the exit window
sections.title_zh: 核对归档数据并明确退出窗口
sections.en:
The existing-account export article says conversations closed for more than thirty days live in archivedcases, not just cases. Reconcile both tables, users, messages and attachments before declaring a dump complete. No export or restore was performed.

The older retention article says deactivated-instance data is erased after sixty days, and some permanent deletion operations are irreversible even during service. Current2026 SaaS terms instead specify thirty days of electronic retrieval after termination, with the signed reference agreement controlling scope. The terms grant limited proprietary service access. Treat these as different contractual/operational scopes; request and verify an export while access is active rather than assuming a sixty-day grace period.
sections.zh:
既有账户导出文章称，关闭超过30天的会话位于archivedcases，而非仅cases。判断数据包完整前，应对照两表、用户、消息及附件。此次未执行导出或恢复。

旧保留文章称停用实例数据60天后删除，部分永久删除操作即使服务有效也不可逆。当前2026年SaaS条款则规定终止后30天电子取回，由签署引用协议决定范围。条款授予受限专有服务访问权。应区分合同与运营范围，在访问仍有效时申请并验证导出，不要假定有60天宽限。
